# How we schedule kitchen fittings

We plan each fitting with the customer two weeks ahead. The joiner who measured the room also fits it.

The guide to [preparing your kitchen for the fitting](https://example.com/prep) lists what to clear.

![Floor plan of a galley kitchen](plan.png)

Avoid words such as "seamless" in customer emails; they say nothing.
